content:
I recently made PR #40495. My goal is to develop the basic theory from the beginning of this textbook. I also have some definitions and lemmas regarding Dirichlet forms and Laplacians to PR later, but I tried to pare down this first PR as much as possible. It currently has only 4 main definitions and sufficient API to demonstrate their correctness.

I know it's still a pretty long PR, but I've included a lot of documentation to try to make it as readable as possible, and I'll try to continue golfing the proofs as much as I can.

@Aaron Anderson @Kyle Miller would either of you be interested in reviewing this PR? (I'm tagging you because you're both listed as authors in the Mathlib file for simple graph, and you both have combinatorics listed as one of the topics you review for.)
Sorry - I don't have much time for reviews at the moment.
